WEBHOOK.description: if your server is need web service! value = True else value = False

MIN_TRANSFER_SPEED_MBPS.description: Minimum average transfer speed target in MB/s (download and upload)

SPEED_CHECK_GRACE_SECONDS.description: Seconds to wait before enforcing minimum speed checks

FORCE_SUB.description: Your force sub channel user name without [@]

ADMIN.description: Add Your User ID multiple is use space to split

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Bot Log Sending Channel (just create a private channel and add bot to admin and take channel id to add this variable) ⚠️ id startswith -100 must

DB_URL.description: Your Mongo DB URL Obtained From mongodb.com

START_PIC.description: Your Bot start cmd Pic from @MT_TelegraPH_Bot

BASE_URL.description: Public Heroku app URL, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com. Used for links and keep-alive.

KEEP_ALIVE.description: Set to 1 to ping /health periodically and reduce Heroku web dyno sleeping; set 0 to disable.

KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between keep-alive pings. Default 600 (10 minutes).
